biography.plain_text: Prince Turki bin Nasser bin Abdulaziz Al Saud was a Saudi royal, senior air-force commander and environmental administrator. long_biography.plain_text:
Saudi Arabia's meteorology and environmental administration gave Prince Turki bin Nasser a public role spanning national policy and international cooperation. As president of the responsible agency, he oversaw work on weather observation, pollution, natural resources and environmental planning. He also chaired the country's Environmental Council, coordinating ministries and government institutions.

At United Nations meetings, Turki represented Saudi Arabia on sustainable development, chemical safety and disaster-risk reduction. The national climate communication issued under his presidency assembled scientists and agencies to document emissions, vulnerability and policy needs. He also supported public environmental awareness through a national society and awards for specialist reporting, extending the administration's work beyond regulation and technical services.
